result: High-risk QA failed. Shared auth/CSRF/audit/admin-or-owner and stopped-state gates are inherited, and native helpers/isolation/source hashing are present. Three concrete defects remain: RCON server stdout/stderr are redirected but not drained; preview silently normalizes away unknown controls and discards PNG SHA-256 evidence; SafeSaveName accepts control characters on Linux. Native import/export routes lack service/HTTP round-trip coverage on this Windows host because the fixture is Linux ELF; current integration coverage only invokes preview CLI. Backend tests/build pass and Docker preview CLI checks pass.

evidence.outcome: Endpoints inherit authorization, CSRF, mutation audit, and admin/owner enforcement; service checks stopped state and explicit confirmation.
Import uses helpers.parse_map_exchange_string; export uses game.get_map_exchange_string and re-hashes source save.
RCON process redirects stdout/stderr without draining either stream, risking startup deadlock.
Preview normalization can silently remove unknown controls and MapPreviewResult exposes no deterministic PNG hash.
SafeSaveName does not reject control characters.
Coverage validates preview CLI/isolation/PNG helper/runner cleanup but lacks NativeMapExchangeService or HTTP route import/export tests.

evidence.ref: dotnet test FactorioServerManager.sln --no-restore; Docker fixture job
evidence.outcome: 76/76 backend tests pass; build passes; native 2.0.77 runtime generates valid Nauvis/Vulcanus previews in isolated container temp paths.

next_slice.summary: Repair RCON process draining/timeout handling, reject unknown preview controls and unsafe names, return PNG hash evidence, and add service/route/native round-trip coverage where the Linux fixture can run.

blockers: RCON stdout/stderr can deadlock startup; preview discards hash and drops unknown controls; unsafe control-character save names are accepted; native import/export route round-trip coverage is missing.
